evidence: Validation label and changes to src/validation.cpp and src/node/chainstate.cpp governing chainstate verification (CVerifyDB::VerifyDB).
rationale: Stops false database corruption errors and startup aborts when chainstate verification encounters missing undo data on pruned nodes or AssumeUTXO snapshots. According to the PR description, fetching blocks via getblockfrompeer restores block bodies without undo records, and 'The AssumeUTXO case can occur with the default checks', which attempts to disconnect blocks at verification level >=3 and falsely reports corruption to prevent node restart.
